rationale: All protected epistemic phrasings retained their strength: “In this sample” still scopes the main effect; “may support” remains a modal hedge; the authors still characterize the moderation results as “preliminary”; and “replication in a broader range of classrooms is needed before drawing a general conclusion” remains intact. The reordered results, active construction, and streamlined transition follow R-1 and R-2 without changing numerical results, citations, limitations, or substantive claims.
